name: cyber-resume-reviewer
title_zh: 一份网安简历，它替你拆成 HR 和机器两眼分别看什么
tagline_zh: 投了 50 份没回音？它不夸你，只对照 JD 逐条打分、删废话、补关键词。
tagline_en: 50 applications, zero replies? It scores your resume against the JD, cuts fluff, and flags wording gaps like.
desc_en: Review, tailor, score, or rewrite IT and cybersecurity resumes. Use for candid critique, job-description fit, exact edits, or complete rewrites; never rank candidates.
why_zh: 不是通用润色，是懂网安岗位黑话的审稿人：CVE、ATT&CK、SIEM 写得含糊它都揪出来。
why_en: Not generic polish—it speaks infosec. It catches vague CVE, ATT&CK, or SIEM phrasing, then restructures for ATS parsers so both.
limit_zh: 只处理 IT/网安简历文本，不读 PDF 排版；评分基于你贴的 JD，没贴 JD 就只做语法检查；不改求职信。
limit_en: Text-only for IT/cyber resumes; no PDF layout. Scoring needs a pasted JD, else grammar-only. No cover letters, no job guarantees—verify facts after.
title_en: A cyber resume split into what HR vs. ATS each scan for
